messages.subject: Whitford exit — instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed on the phone, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on Daniel Whitford's situation. He filed a formal grievance on 18 November and is clearly heading towards a claim. His grievance meeting is this week (4 Dec) — I'm chairing. We want to explore an agreed exit given the reorganisation.

Can you send an engagement letter and set out the team? Charles (CEO) will want to be kept close.

Miriam

messages.subject: RE: Whitford exit — instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam,

Thank you — glad to help. Our engagement letter is attached. Tom Gallagher will run the day-to-day with Elena Marchetti on drafting; I'll keep overall carriage.

On approach: I'd suggest we run the grievance to a proper outcome in parallel with a protected settlement conversation under s.111A. That keeps our options open and reduces the "improper behaviour" risk. I'll prepare a file note framework for the protected conversation.

Please sign and return the acknowledgement when you can.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
sarah.whitfield@whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
